_purpose: Machine-readable codebase index. AI agents: read this first, then only the files you need.
what: Physics simulation framework: octahedral 8-state geometry + FRET coupling + mandala substrate → thermodynamic ground-state solving

src/octahedral_physics.py.does: Dual-pathway FRET engine. angular_energy(sin²) + tensor_energy(eigenvalue L2), α-mixed by problem type. anneal() for ground-state search.

src/mandala_structure.py.does: Fibonacci φ-scaled 8-petal ring geometry. Generates cell positions for SOMSEngine.

src/phi_calculator.py.does: Integrated Information Φ metric. evaluate_integration() → (phi, is_sovereign). Sovereign if Φ>3.0.

src/constraint_agent.py.does: Seed-growth agent lifecycle: COMPRESSED→EXPANDING→EXPLORING→CONTRACTING. Loads atlas data.

src/octahedral_lookup.py.does: Static lookup tables: 8 Gray codes, eigenvalue triples, allowed transitions, φ-stability scoring.

src/geometric_encoder.py.does: GEIS token ↔ binary encoder. Token format: [vertex_bits]|[operator][symbol]. encode_to_binary(), decode_from_binary().

src/atlas_loader.py.does: JSON loaders for atlas/ data files.

src/lattice_handshake.py.does: CVP handshake on octahedral eigenvalue lattice. PulseChip: single-clock mat-vec hardware model. feltscore: signal coherence (0-1). local_anxiety: high-D divergence metric.

g2b.provides: 8-state 3-bit bridge table, sensor suite, GEIS tokens

resilience.provides: Seed expansion, field system, 8-node coupling matrix, geobin bridge, NFS pipeline

problem_alpha._doc: α = angular pathway weight (1-α = tensor weight)

rules: New files: src/, data/, docs/, or atlas/ only.
